notes.title: Second anniversary!
notes.content:
Lovely people,

On the occasion of the second anniversary of [b]Press Lex to Metaverx[/b], the new patch includes:
[list]
[*]Fixed some bugs regarding some images after loading.
[*]Better pace in some parts of the game.
[*]Added chapter titles for both main parts of the game: [b]Random Access Memories[/b] and [b]Incidents in an expanding universe[/b]. (Pop culture references in your face!).
[/list]

If you have played it, recommend it, if you haven´t... Grab that huge sale!
Lex loves you all!

notes.title: Sin título
notes.content:

notes.title: Lex at the Cooking Fest!
notes.content:
Your Majesties,

I can proudly say [b]From Lex to Rex[/b] will be at this year´s Cooking Festival. Even more, I could even go out on a limb and say that it will probably be the only adventure game of all the featured games.

Haven´t played it yet? Want to gift a different and funny game? Next monday will be the chance to do it! Have a feast, carry a truffle, fight a princess and make Bedelia´s famous cake in a secret area!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1794030/From_Lex_to_Rex/]From Lex to Rex[/url]

notes.title: The Metaverx turns one!
notes.content:
Your Majesties, may the 4th... [b]First anniversary![/b]

I have to say that I love this game. The goal was clear from the beginning: to apply everything I learnt in the first one and translate it here. It has been accomplished.

On the other hand, despite having participated in a Steam Next Fest, having a better promotion (From Lex to Rex didn't have any), the wishlist and the congratulation messages, the game hasn't had the expected buzz, although, ironically, it has made more players go to the first one.

In the end Lex has ended up being an extension of myself (if he wasn't already in the first one): someone who has to do everything and persists despite the odds with humour, pretty much my summary as an indie developer.

[b]Both games will be on sale during these days[/b]. Take the opportunity to grab them or recommend them if you consider it (and leaving a review too, this helps a lot).

Keep playing. Lex loves you.

notes.title: February HotFix
notes.content:
Greetings, Majesties,

This minor patch fixes a (weird) problem when picking up the book you need in order to write the FLTR walkthrough (first stage). As I said this bug is a strange one, so please let me know if you still have the same problem. In that case I will implement another solution.

Thank you so much. Keep playing and don´t forget to leave a review, you beauties.

notes.title: Nomination and charity!
notes.content:
Majesties,

Hopefully this Press Lex to Metaverx nomination in the [b]Outstanding story-rich game[/b] category finds you full energy. Probably you´ve already know about From Lex to Rex nomination in the [b]Labor of love[/b] category, and if you didn´t know, now you do. Should you consider it, vote for both games (or any of them and leave a review). I know for a fact many of you have enjoyed them.
In addition to this, part of this month earnings from both games will go directly to the food collection campaign that will take place this same week.

Thanks a lot. Enjoy and keep playing.

notes.title: Guías y logros.
notes.content:
Greetings, Your Majesties,

I have recently updated the walkthrough guide and uploaded a brand new about the achievements. Some of you have asked me how to unlock some of them so now the info is available for everybody. I hope it will be helpful.
Please consider leaving a review of the game, it takes two minutes (less than deciding what to see in Netflix). Steam likes them to make the game more visible and they are quite helpful.
Keep playing and enjoying. Thank you.

notes.title: Summer sale! Reviews! Madness!
notes.content:
Majesties,

Summer sale starts tomorrow, the best momento for you to get any of the games, even both of them with an additional discount. Madness!

I also encourage you to leave a [b]review[/b]. It´s [b]a small gesture that means a lot to us, indie developers[/b].

notes.title: FromLexTV
notes.content:
Majesties,

I hope this patch finds you well. It has come to my attention through different ways that some of you got stuck in different stages of the game. If there´s one thing I want you to experience and enjoy it is the story of the game, so, in order to avoid obstacles, I´ve decided to create a youtube channel as a walkthrough place. 

[url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCKMn7CNX2tBkQirPcmypM-w]FromLexTV[/url]

There you will find both games stage by stage so there will no doubts about how to proceed when you find yourselves stuck (if that´s the case). The Press Lex to Metaverx walkthrough will be fully uploaded during this week (there are four stages uploaded at the moment). I will also upload some videos related to both games, such as game development, pixel art and behind the scenes.

I hope this improves your game experience. If you want to help me back, a review would be much appreciated. Thank you so much and keep playing.

P.S: this patch fixes some typos and a music loop.

notes.title: Your daily minor patch
notes.content:
Majesties, strange things happenned (not to all but just one case is enough to check everything), so:

[list]
[*]Fixed a missed interaction in the stage with your multiple versions (diamond - painting to get a key object).
[*]One dialogue option appeared when it shouldn´t. Fixed, however if this happens again you will still be able to choose it but won´t work if you´re not carrying the item, which is quite obvious (when you see it you´ll understand it).
[*]Another one I can´t remember (going through all the programming melted my brain).
[/list] 

If this weird problems persist (so far everybody has been able to beat the stages and progress) I´ll add some creative solutions (puzzles, gameplay or story won´t be altered).

Thank you so much for your comprehension. Be kind: review.

notes.title: Small patch and thank you.
notes.content:
Majesties, 

First of all: thanks for playing. Developing a game is hard, especially just one person. Thanks to your feedback I´ve polished some minor details (some pixel out of place, two sentences that weren´t translated and an object sharing the same layer).

Many people have written (and will write) me e-mails asking me for free keys. I want you to know that I won´t give any key for free. That would be unfair to all of you who has trusted me and bought the game.

I expect to have a Linux version of the game anytime soon. Minor patches will be on the way as soon as I get some more feedback. If you´re enjoying the game please leave an early review if you wish. Those really help.

Thank you again and keep playing.

notes.title: Launch day.
notes.content:
Majesties, Press Lex to Metaverx arrives today.

I´m so proud of it and everything I´ve learnt. It is a bigger step from the first one in all aspects with an awesome story linked to the gameplay. I´ve spent hours and hours of dedication (I truly don´t want to know how many to avoid a heart attack), sometimes almost going crazy, but here is the result. Being a one-man project it is easy that I´ve missed some typos or bugs, so please, majesties, just let me know and I´ll fix them before you can say blueberry pie.

I hope you play it, enjoy it and support me. Thank you so very much.

notes.title: The Metaverx is coming.
notes.content:
Your Majesties,

The Metaverx arrives on the [b]fourth of May[/b].

A moving story awaits you. See you soon.

notes.title: From Lex to Rex - First anniversary
notes.content:
Today is [b]From Lex to Rex[/b] ´s first anniversary.

It started as a feat (it really was) turned into reality. I have probably said this before, but in the end it has been a learning experience. I can assure you I´ve spent many nights thinking about how solving unexpected bugs or investing more hours than any other person would just to improve the game. There were oppossed emotions, highs and lows and even once I dreamt about a character that didn´t allow me to keep developing the game (can you guess which one?).

Now all this is part of the experience of developing an indie game.

A year later I´m finishing the (unexpected) sequel [b]Press Lex to Metaverx[/b] of which I attach a new image. There will news soon. Meanwhile, keep playing, unlock those achievements, spread the word about the game and if you want to do extra mile leave a review. Every little gesture helps. (And if you haven´t played it, now it´s on sale!).

Thanks for being there.
